implementation: Adapted the preserved V4 circular woven-fiber geometry, five restrained sector tones and central mission nucleus to the current mission slice list and durable slice states. The rendered geometry is deterministic and never measures progress.

Added drag rotation, wheel and button zoom, arrow-key camera inspection, reset, keyboard focus, an explicit SVG-only WebGL fallback and a mobile-flow collapsible inspector; mobile notices, status and camera controls stay outside the scrollable inspector.

The owner-cookie authenticated, read-only Loom route now reads the approved plan and paginates mission-local event history in 1,000-row cursor pages. It enforces an 8-second read deadline and 10,000-event overall evidence cap; exactly 1,000 rows does not itself mean overflow.

The shared typed projector requires complete unique approved-plan slice membership and matching objective, ownership, checks and dependencies. Closure binds each current candidate and lease epoch to all exact certified check IDs, pending intent certificate IDs and SHA-256 digests, then a strictly later integration with matching candidate, tree and review digest; contradictory checks and durable UNKNOWN keep it open.

The browser catches up using after-cursor pages, permits global cursor gaps while checking strict monotonicity, bounds requests and event history, uses a 5-second success poll and bounded exponential failure backoff, and shows stale history without implying live completion.
Named inspector rows cover scheduling decisions, recovery, and lesson candidate/promoted/withdrawn evidence; untrusted labels remain textContent and certificate links are validated same-origin URLs.

Final bounded correction: closure also requires approved-plan scopes and budgets to exactly match the current slice snapshot, and maps every pending certificate ID to a certified check without assuming check-array order. Camera magnification now increases for plus/zoom-in and decreases for minus/zoom-out, with wheel direction aligned.
